decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program builds on core mental health expertise and has a dedicated page, indicating strong strategic alignment.
The carpentry workshop supports sheltered employment and the firm's inclusive mission, though it faces moderate demand risks.
The counseling service for senior living is prominently featured on the home page, reflecting high strategic priority and low withdrawal risk.
The meal delivery service for seniors has only a brief website mention and likely faces operational and competitive challenges, so resources should be reallocated.
